Name: BusLocations Continued
Author: comradesean
Description:
[size=5][b]Bus Locations[/b][/size]

[b]Turn Pam's bus into a valley-wide transit system.[/b]

Ever wished the Desert wasn't the only place worth taking the bus? This mod replaces the vanilla ticket machine with a destination selector, letting you (and content pack authors) add as many bus stops as you want.

[line]

[size=4][b]Features[/b][/size]

[list]
[*][b]Multiple Destinations[/b] — Choose where to go from a clean selection menu at the ticket machine
[*][b]Content Pack Support[/b] — Add new destinations with simple JSON files, no C# required
[*][b]Flexible Pricing[/b] — Each destination can have its own ticket cost
[*][b]Pam Optional[/b] — Configure whether she needs to be at the wheel or if the bus runs itself
[*][b]Controller Friendly[/b] — Full gamepad support
[*][b]Multiplayer Compatible[/b] — Works in both singleplayer and multiplayer
[/list]

[line]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6+
[*]SMAPI 4.0+
[*]Vault bundle completed (the bus needs to be repaired)
[/list]

[line]

[size=4][b]Configuration[/b][/size]

After first launch, edit [font=Courier New]config.json[/font] in the mod folder:

[list]
[*][b]RequirePam[/b] (default: false) — Set to true if Pam must be at the bus stop for it to operate
[/list]

[line]

[size=4][b]For Content Pack Authors[/b][/size]

Adding destinations is straightforward—just create a content pack with a [font=Courier New]manifest.json[/font] pointing to [font=Courier New]comradesean.BusLocations[/font] and a [font=Courier New]content.json[/font] defining your locations. Single destinations or arrays of multiple stops are both supported. See the [url=https://github.com/comradesean/BusLocations]GitHub readme[/url] for full documentation and examples.

[line]

[size=4][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]

Works with modded maps that include "BusStop" in their name.

Downloads.Description:
Multi-destination support, controller fixes, and critical bug fixes. New locations array format for content packs. Configurable RequirePam option. Requires Stardew Valley 1.6+ and SMAPI 4.0+.

i18n Spanish translation added thanks to Hayato2236
